edit.description: Add `flume friction [name]`: bare lists the declared channel's notes (filename, size, mtime); with name, prints that note's bytes verbatim. Undeclared Chain.friction refuses usage-shaped, exit 2.
Cover list, cat-by-name, undeclared-channel refusal, and declared-but-absent-dir empty-list cases.

summary: Add `flume friction [name]` read verb — list or cat the declared friction channel's notes, uninterpreted
tests: bare friction lists declared channel notes (filename, size, mtime)
friction <name> prints that note's bytes verbatim
undeclared Chain.friction refuses usage-shaped, exit 2, naming the missing declaration
a declared-but-absent friction dir lists empty, exits 0
acceptance: flume friction [name] lists/cats the declared channel per spec/cli.md, refusing usage-shaped when undeclared
notes: Resolves the parked 'Friction read verbs' question — spec/chain.md's Chain.friction section already moved to 'interpreting' (not 'reading') its content, licensing this read verb. Mirror src/cli.ts's existing job-status friction-dir resolution (~L519) rather than re-deriving it.

edit.description: Add `flume log [-n N] [--json]`: print the last N (default 10) tick verdicts oldest-first via readTickVerdicts; --json emits records verbatim as JSONL.
Cover default-N human form, --json passthrough, and the no-verdicts-file empty case.

summary: Add `flume log [-n N] [--json]` — print recent tick verdicts, human table or JSONL passthrough
tests: default prints the last 10 verdicts oldest-first as fixed-format lines
--json emits the TickVerdict records verbatim as JSONL, one per line
no tick-verdicts.jsonl prints nothing and exits 0
acceptance: flume log [-n N] [--json] renders tick-verdicts.jsonl per spec/cli.md — human table by default, JSONL with --json
notes: Resolves the partially-addressed 'Verdict read-side in the CLI' question — spec/cli.md now fixes verb name, flags, and both output shapes. readTickVerdicts is already exported (src/index.ts); this is CLI wiring only, no engine surface change.
